items.name: Amberhook Reapers
items.art_brief: Low orchard laborer with twin amber sickles, sprouting shoulder baskets and broad hooked harvest blades; new pale graft shoots frame a compact forward silhouette.
items.gameplay_rationale: Adds a wounded-target harvest decision to the existing objective-rooting infantry: primary melee attacks gain a modest finishing bonus below half health, without improving retaliation.

abilities.name: Bramble Stake
abilities.description: On a held bramble line, Seedcutters steady their defense and root attackers they counter; their primary melee cuts bite harder into rooted targets.

abilities.name: Amber Harvest
abilities.description: Primary melee cuts deal 10% more damage to enemies at half health or less; retaliation does not gain this bonus.

items.name: Bloomchime Whistlers
items.art_brief: Bellflower throat mask, curled pollen blowpipe and hanging seed chimes; a high blooming collar and yellow pollen sacs distinguish the light mobile shooter.
items.gameplay_rationale: Adds a rooted-target ranged payoff to the once-per-battle root shot. The opening prepares a later shot, while allied roots can support follow-up fire after its own snare is spent.

abilities.name: Pollenhook Hitch
abilities.description: Once per battle, a barbed seed dart bursts into clinging pollen and roots a chosen line for the next exchange.

abilities.name: Bloomchime Echo
abilities.description: Ranged attacks deal 10% more damage to rooted enemies, rewarding a follow-up after the opening pollen snare.

items.name: Vinebraid Lashkeepers
items.art_brief: Three braided living whips coiled around interwoven root bracers; long lash silhouette and a layered vine mantle show the greater reach without becoming a heavy shield soldier.
items.gameplay_rationale: Adds reduced-force reach to a defensive retaliator. The player may lash across one intervening step to engage a shooter, or defend for the stronger binding counterattack.

abilities.name: Root Brace
abilities.description: Defensive retaliations lash attackers into root-bound rhythm.

abilities.name: Vinebraid Reach
abilities.description: Braided lashes engage a target from one step away at 70% damage; planted defensive counters retain their binding force.

items.name: Sunspine Kites
items.art_brief: Wide translucent leaf-kite mantle with radial ivory thorn launchers and sunlit seed veins; a spreading triangular canopy distinguishes this nimble ranged organism.
items.gameplay_rationale: Adds a small ranged payoff against harried targets. Repeated pins establish the condition for the next shot and reward cooperating with other harriers.

abilities.name: Bramblekite Pin
abilities.description: A seed-thorn cast from the folded kite mantle tangles the struck line for one exchange.

abilities.name: Sunspine Pursuit
abilities.description: Ranged thorns deal 8% more damage to harried enemies, turning a previous pin into a prepared follow-up.

items.name: Dewglass Restorers
items.art_brief: Blue-green dew reservoirs under a glass mushroom canopy, articulated salve nozzle and unfurling medicinal fronds; visible clear water and fresh shoots communicate restorative support.
items.gameplay_rationale: Adds one prevention or cleansing response against rooting while keeping capped attack-triggered healing. The mender now restores movement as well as surviving health; no resurrection.

abilities.name: Mending Fire
abilities.description: Sporeglass salves ride each successful volley, restoring three health per living Mender up to eight health to one injured allied stack. Fallen creatures cannot return.

abilities.name: Dewglass Unfurling
abilities.description: Once per battle, medicinal dew prevents an incoming root on an allied melee line, clears an ally's roots after firing, or prepares the same protection for later.

items.name: Heartseed Wardens
items.art_brief: Enlarged heart-shaped amber seed shield, seedling spear and overlapping green graft plates; standing guardian with a bright shield core and sheltering foliage.
items.gameplay_rationale: Adds a small retaliation aura for other defending melee stacks. The warden becomes a formation anchor that rewards allied defend orders while retaining its own shield and counterroot.

abilities.name: Heartseed Covenant
abilities.description: Rooted shield counters retain their binding force. Other allied melee stacks deal 8% more retaliation damage while defending.

abilities.name: Amber Seedglass
abilities.description: Overlapping seedglass faces turn the hardest missile edge while the living shield line remains formed.

items.name: Corkheart Ramparts
items.art_brief: Massive ram-like bark body with thick cork layers, fresh white shoots and deeply grounded root feet; short angular horn bark catches missiles and throws back splinters.
items.gameplay_rationale: Adds a small ranged-damage return to the existing thick missile screen. Opponents must decide whether shooting the durable ram is worth the splinter damage; melee bypasses the return.

abilities.name: Barkmantle Brace
abilities.description: A rooted wall stance that punishes attacks with binding counterforce.

abilities.name: Corkheart Splinters
abilities.description: Layered cork reduces incoming ranged damage by 18% and returns 8% of damage received to the shooter when the rampart survives. Existing contact and harried-target bonuses remain.

items.name: Dawnburst Arbalists
items.art_brief: Split branch arbalest with three luminous germinating bolt pods and an extended root-stock brace; trained upright orchard artillery with a clear long firing axis.
items.gameplay_rationale: Reworks its volley around a protected firing lane: an adjacent defending ally or controlled cover, obstruction or breach enables the stronger salvo. The mobile unprotected firing position loses the volley bonus.

abilities.name: Dawnseed Pin
abilities.description: Once per battle, a germinating bolt roots one veteran line just long enough for the grove to reform around it.

abilities.name: Dawnburst Emplacement
abilities.description: An adjacent defending ally or a controlled cover, obstruction or breach enables a 14% stronger ranged salvo, with a further 4% against rooted or staggered targets and 2% while any ally defends.

items.name: Antlerloom Striders
items.art_brief: Long-legged grafted stag with luminous woven root antlers and flowering tendon ribbons; wider interlaced antlers and lean running limbs preserve the fast flanking silhouette.
items.gameplay_rationale: Adds a modest primary-melee payoff against rooted targets. Fast reach can now exploit roots laid by slower grove units, without also increasing its defensive retaliation.

abilities.name: Pinning Reach
abilities.description: Can engage from a step away to pin ranged lines before they reset.

abilities.name: Antlerloom Entwinement
abilities.description: Primary melee attacks deal 12% more damage to rooted enemies; woven antlers exploit a prepared target without strengthening retaliation.

items.name: Blossomchoir Cantors
items.art_brief: Hooded living organism with hanging glass seed bells and flowering organ pipes; a broad sheltering blossom mantle spreads above the ranged choir body.
items.gameplay_rationale: Adds a small melee screen for allied ranged and shield-bearing stacks. The cantor protects its firing choir from contact while retaining one root refrain and conditional volleys.

abilities.name: Seedglass Refrain
abilities.description: Once per battle, a measured seedglass refrain roots a veteran enemy line long enough for Crownroot's formation to answer.

abilities.name: Pollen-Cant Volley
abilities.description: A held root lane lets the cantor braid pollen notes into a harder shot against enemies already caught or staggered.

abilities.name: Blossomchoir Shelter
abilities.description: Sheltering blossoms reduce contact melee damage received by allied ranged or shield-bearing stacks by 5%.

items.name: Orchardheart Matriarchs
items.art_brief: Large many-armed graft mother with fruiting halo boughs, suspended restorative sap sacs and bow-like seed-launching arms; heavy amber heart and translucent green fruit show renewal.
items.gameplay_rationale: Adds capped healing after successful ranged damage to a high-tier salvo unit. Its four shots become a limited renewal resource; healing restores only surviving creatures and cannot revive casualties.

abilities.name: Highroot Graft Salvo
abilities.description: The matriarch seeds living shafts through a prepared firing lane, pressing hardest into enemies already caught by bramble or broken formation.

abilities.name: Orchardheart Sap
abilities.description: Each successful ranged attack restores four health per living matriarch, up to twelve health, to one injured allied stack. Fallen creatures cannot return.

items.name: Evergraft Colossus
items.art_brief: Towering walking orchard with a deep hollow amber heart, crown of successive fresh grafted canopies and huge root fists; interlocking root feet and layered boughs form a living fortress.
items.gameplay_rationale: Adds a defensive rooting counterstroke to the capstone missile shield. The colossus can actively anchor a lane through defend-and-retaliate instead of functioning only as a large passive damage sponge.

abilities.name: Worldroot Rampart
abilities.description: Interlocked root plates absorb incoming volleys and keep the living fortress coherent while the surrounding bramble line grinds down the field.

abilities.name: Evergraft Rootlock
abilities.description: Defending gains one extra cohesion. Defensive retaliation deals 10% more damage and roots its surviving target for one round, reducing initiative by one.
